name: Credit Note and Debit Note Generator
h1: Credit Note and Debit Note Generator
title: Credit Note and Debit Note Generator Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Make a credit note or debit note that refers to the original invoice, with items, optional sales tax and the reason. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Correct an invoice after the sale: a credit note reduces what the customer owes, a debit note increases it.
intro: A credit note is issued when you return money or reduce an earlier invoice, for example for returned goods or a price correction. A debit note is issued when the amount was too low and you need to charge more.
Choose the note type, refer to the invoice number and date, list the items and the reason. Everything is made in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to BIZEASE.
how: Pick Credit Note or Debit Note.
Enter the original invoice number and date, and the reason.
List only the items and amounts being corrected.
Add the sales tax rate if the original invoice carried tax.
example: A customer returns 2 items sold at Rs. 3,000 each on an invoice with 18% tax. The credit note shows Rs. 6,000 plus Rs. 1,080 tax, a total credit of Rs. 7,080.
mistakes: Not referring to the original invoice.
Giving a credit note without writing down why.
Forgetting to reverse the tax on the returned goods.

faq.q: What is the difference between a credit and a debit note?
faq.a: A credit note reduces what the customer owes you. A debit note increases it.

faq.q: Do I need to show tax on a note?
faq.a: If the original invoice had sales tax, the correction usually carries the matching tax. Ask your adviser how your adjustments must be reported.
No. It is a layout for your records. It does not file anything with FBR.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. How credit and debit notes must be reported to FBR or a provincial authority is not checked here. It is not legal or tax advice.
